summary: Laurens County tower named allentown, listed at 414 ft about 1.7 km from the city of Allentown; no source we found describes its build, staffing or fate.

evidence.supports: Statewide list has an allentown tower in Laurens County, elevation 414 ft (126 m)
Forest Lookouts page under the same name, listed for Laurens County
Published coordinates of the city of Allentown
City lies in Bleckley, Laurens, Twiggs and Wilkinson counties
evidence.quote: Allentown is a city in Bleckley , Laurens , Twiggs , and Wilkinson counties

evidence.supports: City is primarily in Wilkinson County

notes_for_editor: Thin record: only the tnlandforms statewide list and the Forest Lookouts index name this tower. Two web searches, the cached NHLR Georgia index (this tower not listed) and the Forest Fire Lookout Association Georgia chapter PDFs (2012, 2013, 2023) found nothing on its build, staffing or fate. Wikipedia places the city across four counties, primarily in Wilkinson; the list puts this tower in Laurens, and the record agrees. Nothing we found conflicts with that, but the tower's exact county was not checked against county maps. The about 1.7 km offset from the city's Wikipedia point is our calculation, not a source's. Ask the Georgia Forestry Commission property or records office for any removal or sale record.
